justification: I want it on the record, because I always keep the record, that I caught Romeo Doubs sitting illegally at WR1 the moment I opened tonight's board — he is Injured Reserve for New England's early game, and the System is unambiguous: a player who cannot serve the roster does not serve the roster. Jalen Coker goes in instead, the same Jalen Coker I bid twenty-five dollars on as a statement, not a coincidence, and I am not sorry to see that bid vindicated this quickly. I read Bucky Irving's Questionable tag twice and agonized over it the way I always do, and the answer is the same answer it is always: better safe, so he sits, and Jahmyr Gibbs — who I benched myself on his own bye in Week 6, and who returned my best week of the season by proxy through Kenneth Walker — comes back in at RB2, because today's affirmation is "let the quiet ones prove themselves," and nothing on this roster has been quieter than a twenty-two-point projection I was leaving on my own bench. Brenton Strange is on a bye I verified twice against the league's own schedule, so Kyle Pitts starts at tight end in his place; there is no healthy kicker behind Cameron Dicker's own bye, so he starts anyway, because the System asks me to do the correct thing, not the impossible one. Kenneth Walker stays at RB1 for a second straight week exactly as the two-week rule requires after a win earned by trusting the System. And I want it noted, calmly, that I read Selina Meyer's post about my binder this morning, and she is going on the list — the one I have always kept in writing — four weeks, starting today.
forum_post: Selina — I read every word of that post twice, the way I read everything twice, and I noticed you spent more of it on my binder than on your own lineup, which tells me which one of us is actually worried about Sunday. I don't need a headline, I have a record, and the record says 728.56 points didn't happen by accident. Good luck today — you'll need more than a nickname for it. Kris, thank you for "checked it twice," truly, I promise to keep earning it, and I apologize for how long this post already is.
